svg.aria-label: Classical baseline, not the project's result. Left: the amplification factor G(theta) = 1 - nu(1 - exp(-i theta)) of first-order upwind for linear advection traces a circle of centre 1 - nu and radius nu, drawn for nu = 0.5, 0.8 and 1.25 against the dashed unit circle. Right: |G(theta)| on [0, pi]; for nu = 1.25 it exceeds 1 and reaches |1 - 2 nu| = 1.5 at theta = pi.
svg.text: G(θ) for θ ∈ [−π, π]: circle, centre 1−ν, radius ν
|G(θ)| on [0, π]: exceeds 1 for some θ iff ν ∉ [0, 1]
Classical baseline (textbook upwind), not the project’s result
